title: Merge version 4.2.1-2 from Debian. This new version allows us to drop some patches applied by upstream.
description:
Merge version 4.2.1-2 from Debian. This new version allows us to drop some patches applied by upstream.

PPA with the proposed package:

https://launchpad.net/~lucaskanashiro/+archive/ubuntu/ha-stack

autopkgtest is still happy:

index 4b4e405..77929a7 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,21 @@
+crmsh (4.2.1-2ubuntu1) impish; urgency=medium
+
+  * Merge with Debian unstable. Remaining changes:
+    - d/t/pacemaker-node-status.sh: Use the output of "uname -n" instead
+      of "node1" as the pacemaker node name.
+  * Dropped:
+    - Upstream patches with post release fixes
+      + [997f62d6] Fix: hb_report: disable dump all tasks stack into dmesg
+      + [cce28254] Fix: crmsh.spec: using mktemp to create tmp file
+      + [e098387e] Fix: bootstrap: use csync2 '-f' option correctly
+      + [669f13b5] Fix: bootstrap: Change condition to add stonith-sbd resource
+      + [ca1f0a7f] Fix: ui_resource: refresh <Tab> should complete resource
+        first
+      + [78ce77e4] Low: hb_report: Fix collecting of binary data
+      [Applied by upstream in version 4.2.1]
+
